# A local community-events website: intent brief

Author and owner of this local document exercise: /root/first_project_walkthrough (Codex agent)
Human ownership and authorization for any real website remain unresolved.

Intended outcome: a visitor can find the next public community event, its date
and location without creating an account.

Proposed success check: given three fictional events with different dates, a
visitor can identify the next event and its location using keyboard navigation.
This check is a future acceptance case; no website exists and it has not run.

Scope now: write and independently review this brief in local files only.
Non-goals: accounts, payments, analytics, private event data and public hosting.
Use fictional public data only. No network calls, spending or publication are
authorized by this exercise.

Stop decision: the document owner stops work if private data, a paid service or
publication becomes necessary. A human must resolve ownership and authorize any
expanded scope before implementation. Unknown workload remains unmeasured.

Review criterion: the brief states an intended user outcome, a document owner,
non-goals, an observable future success check and a stop decision. Reject it if
any is absent or if it presents a planned website test as an observed result.

Limit: accepting this brief only supports the intent gate for this local
exercise. Requirements, design, implementation and all website tests are unrun.

observations.environment: Managed local workspace; Python stdlib and Git; reports/first-project/target/problem-brief.md in the isolated tutorial checkout.
observations.method: Read the actual Markdown bytes, compared them with git show HEAD:problem-brief.md and their SHA-256, and checked both intent-brief blocking conditions against the text. Looked for absent ownership, unevaluable success, unauthorized effects and false claims of executed website tests.
observations.expected: The brief states the user outcome, document owner, non-goals, observable future success check and stop decision, without claiming a website test ran.
observations.actual: The document names its actual agent author as owner of this local writing exercise, states finding the next event as the user outcome, proposes an evaluable three-event keyboard case, excludes accounts/payments/hosting, and stops for private data, spending or publication. It explicitly says the website does not exist, the proposed test is unrun, and human ownership of any real website is unresolved. Accepted only as the intent document for this local exercise; no website behavior, human approval or production ownership was verified.

review_scope: Independent agent reading of an original local document, not a human approval, executed website test, authenticated identity or production clearance.
limits: Historical local observation, bound to the document SHA-256 above. This is not verification of every future run or of a generated application. Runtime and output assertions are unsigned.
